label_intro_html: ZECHE GRUV was born in a bedroom. To make room, the mattress stood up against the wall and doubled as acoustic insulation. It wasn't the most professional studio in the world, but the recording happened anyway, with whatever was at hand and a lot of heart. Today we're an independent label with credits on more than 35 released songs, and over 200 artists have come through the studio.
label_side:
What hasn't changed is the way we work: we're not here to change your idea, we're here to translate it. If something's out of time, we tighten it up so it sounds the way you hear it in your head. We look for the balance between organic, experimental and a twist that helps your song reach more people.

Here you'll find plants, warm lights, breakfast or an afternoon snack. And we're not racing the clock: if we're close to the perfect take, we'll take a few extra minutes to get it.
label_director_bio:
Yaco Santana was born in Brazil and grew up traveling around Latin America, surrounded by drums and the songs his mother sang to him. He trained at the conservatory, studied Music Production at the Escuela de Música de Buenos Aires and deepened his craft through self-directed study. After several years in other jobs, he chose to dedicate himself fully to music, and today it is his living.

His training and listening range from classical to folk and from trap to metal, which explains his affinity for unconventional fusions. He is personally involved in every session, from the first idea to the release.
session_intro: Once a week, two hours, one song a month. No rush, with direction.
session_step1_text: We listen to your references, talk about what you want to say and start building the track.
session_step2_text: We work on the ideas together. If you already have them, we polish them.
session_step3_text: I'm with you on every take: bringing your voice out more, giving it air, finding the flow.
session_step4_text: Arrangements, details and the song ready for mixing and mastering.
session_outro: Then comes distribution and, if you want, the video.

session.name: Recording session hour
session.desc: One hour of studio time with an engineer in the room, an acoustically treated space to record vocals and/or instruments. Great if your song is already arranged and you just need to capture it with professional quality and support.

mastering.name: Mastering
mastering.desc: The last step before release: we balance levels, dynamics and loudness so your song sounds even and competitive on any platform.

mixtering.name: Mixtering (stem mix, up to 8 stems)
mixtering.desc: We mix your song from up to 8 stems — ideal if you already have a solid, advanced production and want a fast, clean mix and master without the full process, saving +40%.

instrumental_catalogo.name: Catalogue instrumental
instrumental_catalogo.desc: Pick an already-composed beat from our catalogue and make it yours, ready for you to record vocals over.

instrumental_personalizada.name: Custom instrumental (4 revisions)
instrumental_personalizada.desc: We build a beat from scratch to your style and references, with up to 4 rounds of adjustments until it's exactly how you pictured it.

coverart.name: Cover art
coverart.desc: Cover art design for your single, EP or album, made to stand out on Spotify and on social media alike.

videoclip.name: Music video (filming & editing)
videoclip.desc: Filming and editing of a music video for your song, start to finish — from the shoot to the final cut, ready to publish.

videolyrics.name: Lyric video
videolyrics.desc: A lyric video synced to your song — a more accessible way to have video content for socials and YouTube.

session_musicians.name: Guitar / bass / drums / backing vocals recording
session_musicians.desc: We bring in session musicians to record over your track, with the instrument and the room already set up.

mezcla.name: Mixing
mezcla.desc: Professional mix of your song; the price depends on the number of channels and the song's length — get a quote by filling in those details.

distro.name: Distribution to every platform
distro.desc: We upload your music to Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music and every other platform.

playback.name: Playback & tuning
playback.desc: This isn't just about building the playback track. On show day, we're there with you: we hand you the finished tracks and run the tune live, in real time, following every nuance of your performance on stage. This is the ZECHE GRUV standard for live shows — zero glitches, zero surprises, professional touring-grade sound from start to finish.
